symptom: burning behind the breastbone after every meal and food that felt stuck
hook: part of the stomach had crept up out of the abdomen and was sitting behind the heart
whatYouSee: A bubble with a fluid level sits behind the heart where lung should be. That bubble is stomach that has slid up into the chest.
whyItMatters: The stomach slides up through the gap the food pipe passes through so acid refluxes freely and a very large hernia can twist and strangle.
treatment: Most are controlled with acid suppression and lifestyle change while large or twisting ones are pulled back down and the gap is tightened surgically.
takeaway: An air-fluid level behind the heart means stomach in the chest so think hiatus hernia.
